admission.justification: Row adapter, frame parser and server provenance validation jointly prevent fabricated source identity/time, and focused tests guard untimed and malformed inputs.

applicability: Chat text selected in a visible single-agent page through the trusted negotiated pick channel and the pinned Paseo 0.11.1 / ReactDOM 19.1.0 row adapter.
conditions: The adapter reads message time from the picked row’s own recorded React props; it performs no timeline request and does not synthesize the current time.
A row with readable structure but no recorded time is refused in place, without posting a pick.
A missing supported page/row structure emits one named unavailability notice for that channel lifetime; ordinary dashboard object/panel picks remain separate.
The dashboard parser requires nonblank text, an agent ID and parseable message time; the server separately rejects malformed agent/time provenance before filing.
exclusions: Ambiguous split-pane agent identity supplies no chat pick.
A missing message ID may remain null; message time may not.
The pinned DOM adapter is unsupported host structure, not a host API guarantee.
